statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; client security risks never accepted above Low
Annual evaluation with an outside reviewer every second year
Annual policy review
Written, time-limited exceptions; never relax a client term
Client terms come first; summary of each client's terms
Vendor list with data held, MFA status, and terms review date
Annual review of the suite provider's SOC 2 report and customer controls
Subcontractors only with written flow-down terms and Client A approval
End of engagement: return or destroy with certificate; tell Client B access is no longer needed
MFA on every service that offers it; authenticator app for the suite
Password manager; no browser-saved passwords; carrier PIN
Standard account for daily work and client portals
Sealed emergency access envelope with the owner's attorney
Monthly review of suite sign-ins and external sharing
Four-level classification including Client Security
Client Security information stays with the client; unsynced encrypted notes container
Client information sent only through client portals
Safeguards Information is not accepted; inadvertent receipt steps
Named-person sharing only; no open links
Register of client information with return dates
Same-day copy of field data; monthly encrypted export; quarterly restore test
Shredding; electronic deletion; drive wiping; destruction records
Six-year retention of security records
No business device or media connected to plant systems; guest network only
regulatory_driver: C-NUCLEAR-S01 (CSR-A (1)); C-NUCLEAR-R01 (73.54 program terms in CSR-A)

statement_summary: One encrypted Client A drive; kiosk scan before each use; wiped after each outage
regulatory_driver: C-NUCLEAR-S01 (CSR-A (2)); C-NUCLEAR-R01 (73.54 program terms in CSR-A)

statement_summary: Field laptop kept offline until replaced
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
Separate business wireless network; unique router password
Photo permits; separate album with sync off; photos to the client portal
No client information in AI tools without client consent and a P10 assessment; predictions never delay checks
Client A training before each access renewal; annual general course
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Client A report within 8 hours; Client B report within 24 hours

statement_summary: Personal information notices per the P08 matrix
No ransom without legal advice and an OFAC check
Runbook walkthrough before each outage
Peer coverage agreement with Client A's consent
Self-report legal actions to Client A's reviewing official
Report behavioral observation concerns
